description:
Author + DESIGN a marketplace AGENT component — a reusable, brand-skinned `<opvs-agent>` block in one of four form-factors. This is the agent-authoring shortcut over `content_create_component`: it bakes marketplace_category='agent', kind='interactive', js_runtime='web-component', the `opvs-agent` CDN dependency, the props_schema, and a brand-inherit token-preset skin — so you don't have to know the `<opvs-agent>` emission recipe (and you can't trip the two traps it hides).

DISTINCT from the `agent_flow_*` RUNTIME tools: those create a kind='agent' FLOW + its OPVS binding. THIS authors a mountable COMPONENT that renders that flow. Pick `form_factor`:
  • section   — full-width in-page block (or a /f/<id> surface). runtime surface=flow.
  • widget    — compact inline card filling its host (side-rail, grid cell). runtime surface=inline.
  • concierge — floating launcher + slide-over over <body>. runtime surface=concierge.
  • headless  — transport+state only, renders NO UI (you build 100% of it). runtime surface=inline + headless.

TRAP 1 (handled): the web-component runtime BYPASSES the css column — the skin is the `--opvs-agent-*` token preset baked INLINE on the element, NOT a css string. Pass `skin` to override individual tokens; omit it for a pure brand-inherit baseline (the tenant's --primary / --surface / --font-body win).
TRAP 2 (handled): form_factor is the marketplace-LOCAL mount taxonomy, NOT the runtime AgentSurface — the tool derives surface + the element's `surface` attribute for you and writes a parity-consistent agent_meta {role?, surface, form_factor}.

After creating: mount it with `page_insert_section` (component_slug=<your slug>, props={flow_id:<kind=agent flow uuid>}), then publish + deploy. Browse agent components by mount with `content_list_marketplace_components` + `agent_form_factor`.

confirm_token.description: Token from a prior dry_run call. Single-use, 7d TTL.

default_flow_id.description: Optional kind='agent' flow UUID baked into default_props.flow_id so the component mounts without per-insert props. Omit to require flow_id at insert time.

dry_run.description: Preview the change without mutating and receive a confirm_token. When omitted, the change is applied immediately (legacy behaviour preserved).

form_factor.description: Marketplace mount taxonomy — section | widget | concierge | headless. Drives the generated <opvs-agent> emission, the derived runtime surface, and agent_meta.form_factor.

is_global.description: Publish to all clients (reserved for is_marketplace_authoring brands — backend forces/validates).

name.description: Display name shown on the marketplace tile.

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

required_scopes.description: Optional OPVS scopes the agent needs (e.g. "crm.read") → agent_meta.required_scopes.

role.description: Optional agent role written to agent_meta.role (the OPVS hire/order handoff key). Discovery-only here.

skin.description: Optional `--opvs-agent-*` token overrides baked INLINE on the element (the css column is bypassed for web components). Any omitted key falls back to the brand-inherit baseline (var(--primary) etc.). Keys: primary, bg, surface, surface_2, text, radius, font_body, font_heading — each a raw CSS value (e.g. "#0b5", "18px", "'Inter',sans-serif").

subtitle.description: Optional default chat header subtitle (default_props.subtitle). Ignored for headless.

title.description: Optional default chat header title (default_props.title). Ignored for headless.

trigger_kind.description: Optional what fires the agent (page-load | scroll-into-view | click | exit-intent) → agent_meta.trigger_kind.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: content_create_agent_component
